description: Append-only log of every call an AI makes through the AI access layer, and of every denial. One row per step: call, preview, approval, rejection, execution. It stores a hash of the arguments, never the arguments themselves.

fields.label: User
fields.description: User on whose behalf the action ran.

fields.label: Principal
fields.description: How the caller proved its identity: a human session or an agent token.

fields.label: Session ID
fields.description: SHA-256 of the conversation id the client sent. The id itself is not stored. Rows of one conversation share this value.

fields.label: Client Info
fields.description: Name and version the MCP client reported, stored only if they have the allowed shape.

fields.label: Stage
fields.description: Step of the flow this row records.
fields.options:
call
preview
approve
reject
execute
resolve
auth

fields.label: Tool
fields.description: Name of the tool that was called.

fields.label: Tool Class
fields.options:
definition
read
write
flow
admin
app

fields.label: Target DocType
fields.description: DocType or report the call was aimed at.

fields.label: Target Name
fields.description: Name of the document the call was aimed at.

fields.label: Arguments Hash
fields.description: SHA-256 of the call arguments. The arguments themselves are not stored.

fields.label: Decision
fields.description: Whether the layer allowed the step, denied it, or it failed unexpectedly.

fields.label: Deny Reason
fields.description: Code that says why the step was denied, for example permission or expired.

fields.label: Proposal
fields.description: Write proposal this step belongs to.

fields.label: Approval State
fields.description: Status of the proposal when this row was written.

fields.label: Result
fields.description: Outcome of an executed write. Unknown means the outcome could not be confirmed.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: Name of the Version document the write produced, if any.

fields.label: IP Address
fields.description: Network address the request came from.

fields.label: Duration (ms)
fields.description: How long the step took in milliseconds.

name: AI Action Log
